claim: When the line search finds no step that lowers the residual, the solver still accepts a step, and it leaves the model in an inconsistent state. With ls_max = 6 the trial steps are a = 1, 1/2, ..., 1/32. The safeguard 'a < 0.02' can never be true at the moment it is tested (the smallest tested a is 0.03125), so the loop simply runs out. After the last failure the code has already (i) restored the rigid bodies' centre and rotation to the pre-step values (line 227) and (ii) halved a to 1/64 (line 228). Then lines 231-233 accept x = xn and g = gnew. These belong to the trial at a = 1/32, with the deformable nodes moved and the rigid-body nodes placed at the trial rigid position. Three consequences follow. (1) The rigid bodies (C3 / C4 pots, where the moments are applied) go back to the old position, while the attached deformable nodes keep the moved one; the next _update re-places the rigid nodes from the restored centre and rotation, so the deformable and rigid parts disagree by the trial step. (2) U and the FEBio convergence norms use ui = a * du with a = 1/64, half the step actually applied. normu is then 4x too small and normE1 2x too small, which biases the solver toward declaring 'converged'. (3) A residual increase is still accepted, so the round-1 change request 'line search must not accept residual increase' (F-0004) is not done. The path is taken exactly when contact status changes (facets engaging, stick / slip switching), which is where gate 2 now fails with NaN in 5 of 6 directions (t 1.2-1.3). A causal link to the NaN is unverified.
evidence: gpufe/newton.py:30 (ls_max=6), :222-228 (loop: break only if improved or a < 0.02; otherwise restore rb, a *= 0.5), :231 (ui = a * du after the loop), :233 (x, g = xn, gnew), :232 (normu, normE1 from ui), :239-240 (dtol / etol tests), :186-188 (_update sets rb c / R then _apply_rigid). Trial sequence: a = 1, 0.5, 0.25, 0.125, 0.0625, 0.03125; the 'a < 0.02' test is evaluated at these values only. work/board/r0002/pi_updates.md (5 directions fail with NaN at t 1.2-1.3 when facets come into contact).
how_to_reproduce: Read newton.py:218-242. Dynamic check: in gate 2 (any direction other than flexion) log the line-search exit (improved / exhausted) per Newton iteration and compare rb['c'] with the mean position of the rigid nodes after an exhausted search.

fix_options.option: On an exhausted line search, do not accept: reject the increment, halve the load increment (FEBio auto time stepper: max_retries / dtmin) and retry from the last converged state; keep stop_unconverged as the last resort
If a step must be accepted, accept the tested a (keep rb consistent: do not restore after the last trial; use the same a for ui) and flag the increment; never count such an increment as converged
Verifier: add a unit test where the line search is forced to exhaust, and check rigid / deformable consistency and convergence flags

summary_zh: GPU 牛頓法求解器的「線搜尋」步驟有程式錯誤。當試過的六種步長都無法讓誤差變小時，程式仍然接受最後一次的試算結果，而且在接受之前，已經先把上下椎骨固定座（剛體）退回原位，所以椎骨固定座和它周圍的組織位置互相矛盾。同時程式用來判斷是否收斂的位移量，只算了實際移動量的一半，因此比較容易誤判為「已收斂」。原本設定的保護條件（步長小於 0.02 就停止）永遠不會成立。這種情況最容易在接觸狀態改變時發生，例如小面關節開始接觸、或摩擦由黏著轉為滑動；這正是目前第二關在五個方向出現數值爆掉的時間點，不過兩者是否有因果關係尚未證實。第一輪要求的「線搜尋不可接受誤差變大」也還沒有做到。
